name: OpenThread Border Router
description: OpenThread Border Router (OTBR) lets you bridge a Thread mesh network to your local Wi-Fi/Ethernet network using a Thread radio dongle. It enables Home Assistant and Matter-over-Thread devices (locks, sensors, plugs, thermostats) to communicate with your smart home stack without relying on a vendor-specific hub like Apple HomePod, Google Nest Hub, or Amazon eero.
short_desc: Thread border router for Home Assistant and Matter
author: ownbee
